item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Here's your weather for Monday, September 21. A fresh new week begins today. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be under a blanket of cloud. The high will be 29 degrees, and the low will be 21 degrees. A warm one, but nothing too fierce. Rain is very unlikely today. Here's something to notice: today is almost exactly as warm as yesterday. Two days the same in a row! Look up at the clouds today. Can you find one shaped like an animal? Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be dull and cloudy, reaching 30 degrees. This week our theme is harvest. This is the time when food is gathered in. That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
